title: Sound manifest (assets/sounds.yaml)
description: T3.7: sound files and their channel, the game events that play them, the ambient loop of each island, and the music: the pools of tracks the music director (client/src/audio/director.ts) shuffles, the places that name them (islands, the underground, the title screen, bosses) and its timings. make validate also checks that files exist, that a vendor/ file has its CREDITS.md row, that every reference is a declared sound of the right channel or a declared pool, that islands exist in world/world.yaml, that bosses are monsters of data/monsters and that a track's entries fall inside it.

file.description: Path under assets/: sounds/... (our own, make sounds, lower case) or vendor/<pack>/... with the pack's own file names (letters, digits, spaces, . _ -; no segment starts with a dot).

seconds.description: A music track's length, s (make music-gemini). A music sound without it is a loop file: it loops.

end.description: Where a music track's body ends, s: its composed ending starts there (at most seconds).

entries.description: Where the music director may start the track, s: ascending, never 0, never past end.

events.description: Event name (client/src/audio/cues.ts) → sound id, or ids to pick one at random.

music.description: The music director's pools, the places that name them and its timings (client/src/audio/director.ts). A boss in view beats an important quest's area (data/quests music), which beats the zone; an ordinary fight never changes the music (the owner, 2026-11-18).

pools.description: Pool id → its tracks (music sound ids), shuffled with no immediate repeat.

underground.description: The pool of the floors under the sea (z > 7).

title.description: The pool of the login, sign-up and character screens.

bosses.description: Monster id (data/monsters) → the pool that plays while one is in view, over everything.

fades.description: Equal-power crossfades, ms, by what changed: another zone or quest area, a boss coming into view, the boss's music letting go, the title screen and the world, the next track of a pool.

dwell_ms.description: A new zone or quest area takes over after this long in it.

boss_hold_ms.description: The boss's music outlasts the last one in view by this.

resume_ms.description: Back in a zone within this, its track goes on near where it was.

gap_ms.description: [min, max]: the ambience between two tracks of a zone or quest area.
